reading: The sketch is a hero section for a landing page ("Lumen") on a deep indigo themed background: a nav bar, a big headline, a subheading paragraph, a CTA button, a frosted-glass bar-chart panel, a frosted-glass panel with a progress ring, and a stat callout card. Typed notes specify exact copy, colors, and panel details, which take priority over the rough sketch shapes.

actions.instruction: Top navigation bar: bold 20px 'Lumen' wordmark on the left, and 'Features · Pricing · Log in' links on the right, white Helvetica text on the dark page backgrou
Hero headline: huge Helvetica heavy, tight-set white letters reading 'Every screen, one glance.'
Subheading paragraph below the headline: 'Live metrics on your laptop, phone and wall, synced in under a second.' in white text.
Pill call-to-action button labeled 'Get Lumen', white background with deep indigo text.
Frosted-glass dashboard panel, 640x400px, 24px rounded corners, thin white border. Inside: a bar chart of 6 white bars rising from 31px above the panel's bottom
Frosted-glass panel, 210x420px, 36px rounded corners, thin white border. Inside, centred and 91px from the top, a 120px white ring 12px thick that is open on it
Frosted-glass stat card showing big bold 30px '+38%' text above smaller 15px 'sessions this week' text.
